messages:
Maria: quick heads-up: i'm proposing a small change to the /v1/chat/completions streaming shape. need quick compatibility sanity checks.

TJ: what are you proposing at a high level?

Maria: right now we sometimes mix function/tool bytes into `delta.content`. proposal is to separate incremental tool payloads from chat tokens. two options: (A) keep `delta` keys like `{\n  \"delta\": { \"content\": \"...\" }\n}` and add `{\"delta\":{\"tool_call\":{...}}}` for chunks, or (B) make `delta.type` explicit, e.g. `{\"delta\":{\"type\":\"tool\",\"payload\":{...}}}`.

Devon: older clients expect `delta` to be either a string or a small object with `role`/`content`. this could break typed deserializers. what's migration path?

Maria: fallback works if we keep `content`for text chunks. for tools, we either add a new key (`tool_call`) or `type` + `payload`. older clients will ignore unknown keys; typed SDKs will need updates.

Samir: strongly prefer explicit `type` enum. typed languages (Go/TS/Java) parse enums better than union-of-shapes. also makes parser deterministic.

Maria: agree. tradeoff: slightly bigger wire format. i think clarity is worth the bytes.

TJ: any implications for streaming parser? finalization semantics? current clients expect a terminal event with `finish_reason`.

Maria: keep `finish_reason` unchanged. final terminal event will be `{\"delta\": {}, \"finish_reason\": \"...\", \"role\": \"assistant\"}` followed by a `done`/EOF frame. streaming sequence examples will be added to the spec.

Devon: please add sample streams for: 1) plain text, 2) function call streaming (start/chunk/end), 3) model fallback case (emit a `fallback_model`/routing frame). SDK owners need concrete samples.

Maria: will add samples. infra-bot, can you queue a docs build after PR merge and run compatibility smoke tests against nightly SDKs?

infra-bot: noted. will run docs build on merge and kick off compatibility job against canary SDKs.

Samir: another detail: tool args may be binary-ish. recommend base64 chunking and include an `encoding` metadata field on the first chunk, plus `total_length` so SDKs can pre-allocate or validate.

Maria: plan: first tool chunk -> `{\"delta\":{\"type\":\"tool\",\"payload\":{\"name\":\"search\",\"encoding\":\"base64\",\"total_length\":12345,\"chunk\":\"SGVsbG8=\"}}}` subsequent chunks omit encoding/length.

TJ: sounds good. can we gate rollout with a flag and a short deprecation window? e.g., 3 weeks and a `--new-streaming` canary.

Maria: yes. i'll add the feature flag, migration guide for SDKs, and a CHANGELOG note. will open a PR today.

Devon: ping me on the PR for the Go SDK changes.

Samir: i'll handle TS SDK, add unit tests for the parser to accept both legacy inline tool-in-content and new `type` frames.

Maria: thanks all. i'll paste the PR link here when it's up and include the sample streams. :heart:

Devon: nice. one more ask: include a short note for integrators about error handling when a tool chunk is malformed (suggest drop/abort strategy + server `error_chunk` frame).

Maria: good call — will include error semantics and suggested client behavior (retry vs abort).
